question: Q2
title: Can a registration date bound a year?
label: Tested, not independently verified
population: Your merge261008-3 1996.txt to 2001.txt .com and .net registrables: 28,215,098 record-years (our export of 2026-10-11 holds none for 1996 to 2001).
query: GET https://rdap.verisign.com/<tld>/v1/domain/<name>; compare the year of its registration event with the record year; 404 is not registered now.
result: 48 of 200 (24%) registered after the record's year; 96 not registered now
finding: Today's registration date can neither assign nor bound a past year: for 24% of sampled record-years it falls after the year your files prove, by a median 15.5 years.
limits: Historical WHOIS, which could show earlier registrations, is Pending validation. Verisign's terms bar high-volume automated queries, so this suits samples, not bulk.
